subject: Future Tech
title: Radar: Seeing Through Weather
description: A short lesson to help you apply Radar: Seeing Through Weather.

hook.text: Radar has guided aircraft since World War II.

buildup.text: Radar uses radio waves that bounce off objects.

discovery.text: Modern automotive radar operates at 77 GHz, detecting objects up to 250 meters away and measuring their exact velocity.

twist.text: Radar can't tell a plastic bag from a rock. It lacks the resolution to distinguish object shapes.

punchline.text: When cameras go blind, radar keeps watching.

quiz.question: What is radar's key advantage over cameras and lidar?
